notes: Part A (Madrid, Cataluña, C. Valenciana, Baleares, Aragón, País Vasco, Navarra, La Rioja): Part A of Spain (Madrid, Catalonia, Comunitat Valenciana, Balearic Islands, Aragón, Basque Country, Navarra, La Rioja) plus national poison-line check. POISON LINE: The INTCF Servicio de Información Toxicológica (+34 915 620 420, 24 h/365) is a human poison centre; its page does not mention animals, pets or vets, so it is NOT listed. The only Spanish service found whose page explicitly serves veterinary cases is SERTOX (Universidad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria), which offers a toxicological information service by phone/e-mail to the veterinary community; it is listed as poison_line but is an office/lab service (no hours, not 24 h, not an emergency hotline). No dedicated animal poison hotline (like an APCC equivalent) was found for Spain. DUTY ROTAS: No official guardia/duty rota page was found for any part-A region. COLVEMA (Madrid) and COVB (Barcelona) offer centre finders (COLVEMA has an urgencias filter; COVB filters only by centre type), COVT (Tarragona) and COVGI (Girona) have centre finders without rotas; Gipuzkoa/Navarra/Bizkaia colegio sites did not surface any guard service. In Spain urgent care is covered by private 24 h hospitals, so duty_rota count = 0. BLOCKED / NOT REACHABLE: hvarturosoria.com (Madrid, robots), hvmontjuic.com (Barcelona, error), veterinaririeraalta.com (placeholder page), clinicaveterinariasanjorge.com (Ibiza, robots — entry sourced from Vet at Home Ibiza page, needs check), vetsciutadellaclinicaveterinaria.com, canisgirona.com (Girona city Canis Hospital Veterinari — no own page opened, not listed), blanesveterinario.com, clinicaveterinariapetdoctors.es (Torrevieja), centroveterinariorioja.com (robots), noticiasdegipuzkoa.eus, madridsalud.es (error), hcv.uab.cat and anicura.es clinic list (not openable). LEFT / FOLLOW-UP: Girona city 24 h hospital (Canis) needs an own-site source; more Ibiza/Formentera and Menorca clinics; Hospital Veterinario Menescal (Novelda) left out because its page says both 'Atención 24h' and 'Urgencias 24h: 6.00 - 00.00'; Valencia CEU/other Alicante 24 h clinics (Almoradí DRL, Benidorm others); COLVEMA has more 24 h centres (e.g. Mascotiti, Hospital Veterinario Sierra de Madrid, Hospital Felino Madrid) not yet opened; remaining COVGI finder pages; Basque Government list has more emergency-service clinics (Irun, Durango, Arrigorriaga, Vitoria Ariznabarra) not added. || Part B (Andalucía, Canarias, Murcia, Galicia, Asturias, Cantabria, Castilla y León, Castilla-La Mancha, Extremadura): Part B (Andalucía, Canarias, Región de Murcia, Galicia, Asturias, Cantabria, Castilla y León, Castilla-La Mancha, Extremadura). DUTY ROTAS: none found. No Colegio Oficial de Veterinarios or regional-government page listing who is on duty could be located for these regions (search tool returned no Colegio guardia pages); Canarias7 Jan 2026 reports the Colegio de Las Palmas considers 24 h cover on Fuerteventura/Lanzarote not viable and runs no rota. NOT REACHABLE: HCV Universidad de Córdoba (uco.es/empresa/hcv — robots_disallowed; not included); unex.es veterinaria pages (robots/client error); rofcodina.org (blocked) so Rof Codina 24 h unconfirmed; hcv.ulpgc.es/contacto (server error); veterinariovetsurtenerife.es (client error); fuerteventuraenimagenes.com (client error); UNAVETS Lugo clinic page (Hospital Veterinario Ciudad de Lugo — listing says 24 h but its page could not be opened; not included).
